description: Spawns an agent that adds a VFX effect for one specific building or enemy type: a tuned procedural effect (or new engine/vfx emitter family) bound through a new open per-type trigger, plus a placeholder vfx_* sprite slot for later art. There is no image-generation tool in this repo, so the visual comes from tuned numeric particle parameters (colour, shape, velocity, life), not generated pixel art.

fields.description: The building or enemy TYPE this effect belongs to, e.g. 'Storm Priest' or 'Drummer' — becomes the triggers_by_type key.
fields.label: Building/enemy type

fields.description: Whether the target is a building or an enemy type — picks which watcher call site (watch_buildings vs watch_enemies) gets wired.
fields.label: Target kind

fields.description: When the effect fires. Pick "New moment" to name one not listed — attack/death/place/hit/tier_up/level_up are just the common cases, not a closed set.
fields.label: Trigger moment

fields.description: Try to match an existing engine/vfx emitter shape (spark/slash/muzzle/splatter/beam/crater/lightning/gold_highlight/drummer_aura) before defining a brand-new dataclass+emitter.
fields.label: Reuse an existing procedural shape

title: Add New VFX Effect
